Definitions of package and packaging For purposes of this subchapter, the term "package" means a bottle, can, keg, barrel, or other original consumer container, and the term "packaging" means the filling of any package. (Added Pub. L. 85–859, title II, §201, Sept. 2, 1958, 72 Stat. 1390 ; amended Pub. L. 91–673, §3(e), Jan. 12, 1971, 84 Stat. 2057 .)

entries: Pub. L. 91–673 substituted definitions of package and packaging for definitions of bottle and bottling.

other_notes.heading: Prior Provisions
other_notes.text: A prior section 5416, act Aug. 16, 1954, ch. 736, 68A Stat. 676 , consisted of provisions similar to those comprising this section, prior to the general revision of this chapter by Pub. L. 85–859.
